result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its content, IP and data; TrueLink assigns Client-specific Support Services work product; Client receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP; TrueLink retains the Interface; and joint ownership is expressly excluded. The existing nonexclusive Credit Data licence remains broad but does not transfer ownership, so it does not defeat this ownership rule. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing commercial structure. Drafting is generally professional, though the pre-existing definition contains the grammatical error “any or its,” and the duplicate subsection lettering remains.
